AI is being embedded into our company DNA, across every department. For further information, please read our guide: ‘AI at Deriv:How we’re transforming fintech with AI’ .
**Your challenges:**
AI Solution Development
* Design, build, and operate agentic LLM applications with tool\-use/function calling, planning, memory, and structured outputs with versioned prompts.
* Implement RAG pipelines (hybrid dense\+sparse retrieval, reranking); manage vector indices and the embedding lifecycle.
* Integrate models with internal services and third\-party APIs via tool adapters; enforce schema contracts and access controls.
* Lead feature work in recommendation/ranking, content generation/editing, and workflow orchestration backed by measurable eval metrics.
Security \& Automation
* Build AI\-driven security automations: classifiers/anomaly detectors, red\-teaming harnesses, and (where appropriate) autonomous testing agents.
* Implement safety \& privacy controls: prompt\-injection/jailbreak defenses, PII redaction, policy filtering, and auditability.
* Stand up real\-time tracing \& alerts on token/latency/cost, retrieval degradation, drift, and hallucination risk.
Project \& Task Management
* Own model/prompt/agent versioning and ship via CI/CD with canaries/A\-B, rollback plans, and clear SLOs (quality, latency, cost).
* Evolve workflows: PR\-based changes to prompts/configs, experiment tracking, concise design docs, and ADRs (decision records).
Quality Assurance \& Code Review
* Enforce evaluation\-first development: golden sets, synthetic probes, regression tests for prompts, grounding/faithfulness checks.
* Review for determinism, observability, and reproducibility; address tech debt with a bias to stability and measured impact.
Collaboration \& Mentorship
* Partner with platform/data teams on data contracts, retrieval standards, and tenancy/access control.
* Mentor peers on agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, and safe rollout; lead design reviews and share practical research findings.
Continuous Improvement
* Benchmark and integrate new model families/tools via standardized bake\-offs; report quality–latency–cost trade\-offs.
* Optimize serving with adapters/LoRA, distillation/quantization, routing/caching/speculative decoding; right\-size infra for cost/perf.
* Track industry and research trends; convert into pragmatic, incremental stack upgrades.
**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face).
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Solid understanding of security best practices and experience with security automation is a plus.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
* Experience with task management and code collaboration tools (GitHub, Jira, ClickUp, etc.).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a fast\-paced, collaborative team.
Nice to Have
* Experience in AI/ML engineering, with a proven track record of delivering production\-grade solutions.
* Experience with marketing automation, content generation, or design systems.
* Familiarity with Figma, Supabase, or similar platforms.
* Contributions to open source AI/security projects.
* Prior experience in a high\-growth tech or fintech environment.

Chez KPMG, vous ferez partie d’une équipe diversifiée et dévouée de professionnels de la résolution de problèmes ayant un objectif commun traduire l’information en occasions pour nos clients et nos communautés partout dans le monde.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne dynamique et dotée du sens des affaires pour se joindre à notre équipe à titre de développeur ou développeuse en IA générative / plateforme Power. Ce rôle met l’accent sur le développement d’agents d’IA et d’agents Copilot à l’aide d’outils comme Copilot Studio et Azure OpenAI. La personne idéale comblera l’écart entre les besoins du cabinet et les solutions techniques en jouant un rôle hybride qui combine des connaissances en développement à la gestion de projet et à l’engagement des parties prenantes.
**Ce que vous ferez**
* Concevoir et intégrer des capacités d’IA générative et des solutions agentiques telles que des agents d’IA à l’aide de Copilot Studio, de la plateforme Power de Microsoft et d’outils connexes
* Développer et gérer des connecteurs, des API et des intégrations d’IA personnalisées à l’aide de systèmes d’entreprise, notamment ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks
* Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions à l’aide de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder)
* Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du cabinet pour recueillir, interpréter et traduire les exigences en solutions d’automatisation intelligente
* Prendre en charge le cycle de vie complet de la solution, de l’idéation et du prototypage au déploiement et à la maintenance
* Veiller à ce que les solutions soient sécurisées, évolutives et conformes aux normes d’architecture d’entreprise
**Ce que vous apportez au rôle**
* Diplôme en sciences informatiques ou formation équivalente.
* Solides compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication, et capacité d’interagir avec des utilisateurs professionnels et des équipes techniques.
* Passion pour l’innovation en IA et solide compréhension de la façon d’appliquer l’IA générative aux défis commerciaux réels.
* Capacité de gérer de multiples priorités et d’obtenir des résultats de grande qualité dans un environnement dynamique.
* Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles et dans des environnements de développement agiles.
* Être à l’aise avec l’ambiguïté et avoir la volonté de prendre des initiatives et de s’approprier les résultats.
Compétences techniques
* Expérience avec Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio et les modèles d’IA générative (p. ex., GPT\-4\)

* Solide compréhension des modèles d’orchestration des agents d’IA, de RAG (génération augmentée de récupération), de modèles d’IA générative (petits et grands modèles de langage) et d’ingénierie de requêtes
* Maîtrise de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate et Power Virtual Agents)
* Expérience en développement et en résolution de problèmes dans SharePoint Online, particulièrement avec l’intégration aux solutions d’IA agentique et à la plateforme Power
* Expérience en matière de rôles de sécurité infonuagique et de création d’entités personnalisées
* Maîtrise de Dataverse, des API, des connecteurs et des stratégies d’intégration
* Expérience des méthodes agiles et des pratiques DevOps
* Capacité à programmer en Python et JSON
* Connaissance des plateformes infonuagiques (Azure, AWS, etc.) et des technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
* Familiarité avec l’intégration de ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks (un atout)
* Connaissance d’Azure AI Services et d’Azure AI Foundry (un atout)
* Les certifications telles que Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, PL\-200 ou PL\-400 sont un atout

Imagine a world where every small business has the power to thrive. That's the world we're building at iwoca. Small businesses aren't just statistics – they're the heartbeat of our communities, the character of our high streets, and the engine of our economy. Since 2012, we've revolutionised how these businesses access finance, turning what was once a lengthy, frustrating process into something remarkable: funding that's fast, flexible, and actually works for modern businesses.

Our impact speaks for itself: we've provided billions in funding to more than 150,000 businesses across Europe, making us one of the continent's leading fintech innovators. But we're just getting started. Our mission? To empower one million businesses with the financial tools they deserve.

**The function**

iwoca's Data Scientists specialise in supervised machine learning, statistical inference and exploratory data analysis, focusing on tabular and time series data. Our work emphasises quantitative predictions through the analysis of conditional probabilities and expectations, using medium\-sized datasets.
**The team**

The DE Acquisition Tech team sits at the heart of iwoca’s growth strategy. Its mission is to help Marketing and Sales reach and engage small businesses of every kind, showing how our finance can empower their ambitions. The team enables smarter, data\-driven decision\-making across paid and organic channels as well as direct sales. As a Data Scientist in the DE Acquisition Tech team, you’ll shape how iwoca grows. You’ll design and evaluate experiments, build statistical and predictive models, and turn complex data into clear insights. You’ll own projects end to end while working closely with stakeholders to align your work with business goals. The models and insights you deliver will directly influence how we invest in sales and marketing, giving you visibility across the company and impact on customer acquisition.

You’ll shape projects that:
* Run controlled experiments across paid and organic channels, generating evidence on what drives conversions.
* Build and refine frameworks for Paid Search and Paid Social, enabling smarter bidding and more effective performance.
* Develop statistical attribution models to give clear insight into channel impact.
* Design predictive lead scoring models that help target valuable prospects more effectively.

* Expertise in probability and statistics, gained through a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics or similar.
* Ability to understand business context and translate data into actionable insights that guide decisions.
* Proficiency with data manipulation and modelling tools such as pandas, statsmodels or R.
* Experience with scientific computing tools such as NumPy, SciPy, R, Matlab, Mathematica or BLAS.
* Ability to work autonomously and manage projects end to end, from framing the question to delivering outcomes.
* Ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech, adapting technical detail to suit different audiences.

* Understanding of Bayesian statistics, including experience or interest in applying hierarchical Bayesian models.
* Experience building machine learning models from scratch, including creating custom optimisers.
* Knowledge of stochastic processes and related mathematical techniques.
* Experience working with Python, our primary programming language.
* Understanding of financial concepts such as deterministic cash flows.

We expect to pay from £60,000 \- £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open\-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

As a SSE in AI for Climate you will be part of a large community of over 100 Scientific Software Engineers (SSE), supporting and enabling cutting\-edge science at the Met Office.

We are seeking two talented individuals to join our efforts in advancing machine learning applications for climate science. The first role will be helping to develop our ML\- based downscaling capabilities. Whilst the Met Office has a wealth of information on global weather and climate, traditionally we have relied on physics based models to translate these to local scales relevant for impact. However, these traditional approaches are computationally costly and time consuming to perform, which has limited our ability to translate much of our global data to local scales. Emerging ML approaches have the potential to learn from physics based datasets to produce locally relevant climate and weather information, augmenting our high\-resolution modelling capability. This role will join a team testing, evaluating, and developing ML approaches.

The second **Scientific Software Engineer in AI for Climate** will help to join our pioneering work in Data\-Driven Climate Modelling (DDCM) as part of the Met Office’s AI4Climate initiative. This is your chance to apply cutting\-edge machine learning and AI to one of the most urgent challenges of our time—understanding and predicting Earth’s changing climate in the Earth System Data Science team. In Earth System Data Sciences team, you’ll work in a multidisciplinary team of scientists, software engineers, and external collaborators to develop and evaluate data\-driven climate models that complement traditional climate projections. Your contributions will help to build the Met Office’s capacity to adapt, assess, and ultimately create its own data\-driven climate models—tools that are faster, more flexible, and scalable for climate change applications and climate services to public.

In these roles you will undertake research and development in the use of data science and machine learning for climate prediction, including model evaluation and interpretation. You will contribute to projects under the AI4Climate project, working with colleagues across the Met Office and with external partners. You will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of partners with different areas of expertise both in the Met Office and with partner universities, other Met Services, research institutions and commercial partners. Through tackling these challenging problems together, you will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of skills in machine learning and data science.
